state.task: Advise on finishing canlang v1, a new AI-authored DSL for companies replacing CRUD-centered business SaaS. We are writing a precise design, not implementing its compiler now. Adoption, concise source, predictable generation and one canonical primitive matter. Existing 35 drafts mix real constructs with English pseudocode. Preserve user requirements: Given/When/Then per logical package, packages independent of files, workerd, Cloudflare services, PatternFly HTML/CSS, HTMX, one app MCP server, # documentation and ## ordinary comments. Do not assume any option is preferred just because it is listed first.

evidence.typing: Current reschedule(appointment,start) uses typed Appointment.start later; source names alone do not establish parameter types. Other parameters refer to unrelated models, unions, or arbitrary JSON fields. MCP needs a definite JSON input schema. Each model already has typed fields.
evidence.scope: Current draft Deal.stage sometimes denotes an instance field, sometimes a query column. Nested UI lists use row ambiguously; some guard fields are unqualified. Repeated fully qualified field paths cost tokens, but guessing a record can alter authorization or writes.
evidence.sources: CanShift declares a human role scheduler and has by=scheduler workflows. Other apps have scheduler background handlers. Provider callbacks and team-removal hooks must not appear as user MCP tools.
evidence.effects: Existing lines concatenate set/create/freeze/history/emit effects without separators. Actual English helper phrases sometimes have no declaration. User permits useful compactness but forbids invented business behavior.
evidence.storage: Cloudflare D1 exposes atomic SQL batches, not a JavaScript read/branch/write transaction callback. Pure workflow evaluation can happen between a read and a guarded commit. A global internal revision incremented by every app mutation, checked inside the final atomic batch before writes/receipt/outbox, can conservatively detect even phantom changes. All effects must be deferred until commit. Durable Object local storage transactions are an alternative for authoritative coordination. Cross-service atomicity is unavailable. No throughput benchmarks exist yet.

operation_types.instructions: Which rule gives v1 definite tool schemas with a compact predictable source?

criteria.explicit: Type every scenario parameter, allowing Model.field as an exact type reference; defaults can infer literal primitive types. No inference from arbitrary body usage.
criteria.usage_inference: Infer all parameter types from name and body usage; require annotations only when the compiler encounters ambiguity.
criteria.unresolved: The supplied evidence does not justify either rule.

record_scope.instructions: Which field-binding rule is preferable for correctness and local readability?

criteria.lexical: Allow bare fields only in a statically established current-record scope; otherwise require explicit record aliases. Never interpret a type name as a current record.
criteria.qualified: Require an explicit receiver for every field reference, even inside a known record scope.
criteria.contextual: Retain model-name current records and infer an implicit receiver from whatever declarations are in scope.

trusted_sources.instructions: How should user workflows and trusted handlers be distinguished for MCP?

criteria.on_source: Keep by= for user predicates; use on= for typed trusted triggers on the same scenario primitive. A triggered handler is not a user tool.
criteria.qualified_by: Use by= for both, but require a reserved source namespace for trusted callers and another namespace for roles.
criteria.infer: Infer whether a caller is a user or system from its name and surrounding declarations.

statement_boundary.instructions: Which effect grammar best balances compactness and unambiguous parsing?

criteria.separators: Separate statements by newline or semicolon, with indentation for blocks. Prohibit unseparated command chains and undeclared helper phrases.
criteria.newline_only: Require every statement on its own line, including short related assignments.
criteria.keyword_chain: Keep unseparated effects and treat effect keywords as implicit statement boundaries.

default_storage.instructions: Given small business scope, choose the most coherent default design while retaining explicit authority declarations.

criteria.d1_fenced: Keep D1 default and specify guarded optimistic commits using a runtime-controlled revision, bounded pure evaluation, atomic write/receipt/outbox batch, and bounded retries. Document coarse contention and require a runtime prototype before claiming performance.
criteria.d1_sql_subset: Keep D1 default but restrict its workflows to statements fully expressible in one SQL batch; procedural workflows must use a declared Durable Object authority.
criteria.do_default: Change the default mutable store to Durable Object SQLite; use D1 only as a read projection when requested.
criteria.unresolved: Evidence is insufficient to select a storage design.
